title: Bitpanda Staking is here!
notes: First-party launch announcement documenting Bitpanda Staking, weekly rewards and initial product mechanics.

title: Earn up to 7% APY on stablecoins: Make your assets work for you
notes: First-party announcement introducing Earn on Stablecoins to the Bitpanda Earn suite and disclosing title transfer, counterparty and insolvency risk, lack of regulated custody during the Earn transaction, and lack of deposit protection.

title: Bitpanda Earn
notes: Current first-party Earn surface describing Staking, Earn on Stablecoins and Passive Earn and distinguishing the staking and stablecoin-yield mechanisms.

title: Earn on stablecoins
notes: Current first-party Helpdesk material stating that ownership transfers to Bitpanda during the stablecoin Earn transaction, the customer becomes an unsecured creditor, and partial or total loss is possible in insolvency.

title: Bitpanda Legal, Regulatory & Privacy
notes: Current first-party legal index listing separate Staking Terms and Earn Terms, supporting product-specific rather than umbrella-wide terms treatment.

title: CEX.IO Earn Crypto
notes: Current first-party Earn surface presenting CEX.IO Staking and CEX.IO Savings as distinct Earn mechanisms.

title: Updated: Introducing cryptocurrency Savings
notes: First-party update stating that Savings entered open beta as a full-fledged service under the CEX.IO Earn umbrella and describing lending-related yield mechanics.

title: Important updates to our Staking and Savings Services
notes: First-party notice that Automated Crypto Staking would be suspended on 2025-04-01 while reward structures for continuing Staking and Savings programs were updated.

title: CEX.IO Savings
notes: Current first-party Savings surface documenting dedicated Savings balances, current flexible rewards and redemption mechanics; the page also contains inconsistent statements about current Locked Savings availability, so locked-product availability is not generalized.

title: Staking
notes: First-party Staking documentation describing rewards linked to proof-of-stake mechanisms and CEX.IO account balances.
